title: SAR Doppler tomography research started in 2018

tellings.quote: time 6 or 7 years, we we began 2 years before the the papers. So, in 2018

plain: Research meant to look beneath the pyramids of Giza, Egypt, using satellite radar began in 2018, two years before any papers came out. Filippo Biondi, a researcher who took part, tells Michels this. The method he uses is called SAR Doppler tomography, a way of reading the echoes of synthetic aperture radar (radar that images the ground from satellites) to picture what lies under the surface. The date matters because it shows the work behind his claim of a vast structure under the pyramids had been going on for six or seven years.
